# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** 9 years old  <sub>[v3 c18 P9](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0009)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a round-headed, fair-complexioned lad with a crop of fuzzy little yellow ringlets all over his head. He has roguish hazel eyes, a snub nose, and a smile that features a single dimple in one cheek, giving him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Davy is an energetic, curious, and inquisitive boy driven by a lively interest in the world around him. He is heedless, disobedient, and mischievous by nature, often getting into trouble before considering the consequences of his actions. Despite his tendency for mischief, he is cheerful, practical, and possesses an innate knack for winning affection. Over time, he matures into a reformed character and takes a keen interest in practical pursuits like farming.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c18 P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)_

## History

Following the death of his sick mother, Davy and his twin sister Dora were taken in by Marilla Cuthbert at Green Gables. Unaccustomed to proper discipline in his early childhood, he caused constant distraction and mischief upon his arrival, such as locking his sister in a shed and ruining lemon pies by falling on them from a pantry shelf. Davy quickly formed a deep attachment to Anne Shirley, who helped guide his upbringing and morality. He began attending school, sitting beside Milty Boulter, though his unruly antics continued, including cutting up Dora's aprons, scaring Mrs. Rachel Lynde with a jack-o'-lantern, and chasing Mrs. Lynde's rooster until it died. He also ran away from Sunday School to go fishing with the Cotton boys. As he grew older, Davy reformed his rebellious tendencies and settled into a helpful, clever young boy. By his ninth year, he developed a strong passion for farming and sought permission from Marilla to run the Green Gables farm.

## Background by volume

- lost his father when he was a baby  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
- never had early training during his mother's illness  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c10 P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061)</sub>

- went without cake during his mother's sickness  <sub>[v2 c8 P13](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0013)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m going to be good, but can’t you be good running round just as well as sitting still?  <sub>[v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>

> I ain’t going to be a minister. I’m going to be a storekeeper, like Mr. Blair, and keep heaps of candy and bananas.  <sub>[v2 c14 P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031)</sub>

> I forgot. You’ve told me not to do such an awful lot of things that I can’t remember them all.  <sub>[v2 c17 P30](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0030)</sub>

> I mean to live to be a hundred years old, like Mr. Thomas Blewett of White Sands.  <sub>[v3 c14 P43](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0043)</sub>

> I’ve growed a whole inch since you left. I’m as tall as Milty Boulter now. Ain’t I glad.  <sub>[v3 c40 P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006)</sub>
